headlines.shortLinkText: Oilers beat Canucks 5-1 to force deciding Game 7 in second-round series

events.name: Edmonton Oilers at Dallas Stars

headlines.description: — Oilers captain Connor McDavid felt absolutely miserable sitting in the penalty box after he was called for a double-minor penalty only seconds into the first overtime of the Western Conference Final opener.
headlines.shortLinkText: McDavid gets the winner in the 2nd OT after Oilers overcome captain's penalty to beat Stars 3-2

events.name: Florida Panthers at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Tough guy Matt Rempe added the excitement the Rangers lacked in Game 1 against the defending Eastern Conference champion Florida Panthers. Linemate Barclay Goodrow gave New York and its fans something even more important — an overtime goal.
headlines.shortLinkText: Goodrow scores in overtime, Rangers outlast Panthers 2-1 in Game 2 to even Eastern Conference final

events.name: Edmonton Oilers at Dallas Stars

headlines.description: — Mason Marchment and the Dallas Stars were playing with a Game 7 mindset, even though it was only the second game of the Western Conference Final and it took them a bit to really get in that mode.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mason Marchment breaks 3rd-period tie, Stars beat Oilers 3-1 in Game 2 to even West final

events.name: New York Rangers at Florida Panthers

headlines.description: — Igor Shesterkin gave the New York Rangers a chance. Alex Wennberg got just enough of his stick on the puck to become the hero.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wennberg scores in OT, Rangers top Panthers 5-4 to take lead in East finals

events.name: New York Rangers at Florida Panthers

headlines.description: — The Florida Panthers couldn't have asked for a better scenario. Sam Reinhart, alone in the slot, on the power play.
headlines.shortLinkText: Reinhart scores in OT, Panthers beat Rangers 3-2 in OT of Game 4 of East final

events.name: Dallas Stars at Edmonton Oilers

headlines.description: — Kris Knoblauch thought he might be in for a long night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Oilers beat Stars 5-2 in Game 4 to tie Western Conference final

events.name: Florida Panthers at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — The Florida Panthers are on the verge of going back to the Stanley Cup Final for the second straight year and third time in franchise history because they are finding ways to win the tight ones.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers beat Rangers 3-2 in Game 5 to move within win of Stanley Cup Final return

events.name: Edmonton Oilers at Dallas Stars

headlines.description: — Ryan Nugent-Hopkins and the Edmonton Oilers went into Game 5 of the Western Conference Final determined to score if they got a power-play chance.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nugent-Hopkins scores 2 power-play goals and Oilers beat Stars 3-1 to move a win away from Cup final

events.name: New York Rangers at Florida Panthers

headlines.description: — The Prince of Wales Trophy was carried onto the ice when time expired, as an arena filled with Florida Panthers fans roared in delight and dozens of players and staffers rushed over to pose...
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers going back to Stanley Cup Final, top Rangers 2-1 to win East title in 6 games

events.name: Dallas Stars at Edmonton Oilers

headlines.description: — For the Edmonton Oilers, the journey from worst to first in the Western Conference is complete. And now a chance at the Stanley Cup is their reward.
headlines.shortLinkText: Oilers top Stars 2-1 for West title, will play Florida in the Stanley Cup Final
